selection_rule: From the test split, keep memes the re-fitted model misclassifies on Task A (predicted label != true label, measured). Rank them by descending image-block absolute-SHAP share (sum of |SHAP| over image columns 0:768 divided by the sum over all 1536 columns). Break ties by ascending integer image_id. Keep the top 6. No example is hand-picked; the set is a deterministic function of the measured SHAP values.
